audit_purpose: tier-up resolution on non-unanimous Sonnet labels (4-of-5 + 3-2 splits); HU-1.5-LK-10 separately owner-adjudicated

reasoning: HU spot — Tc removed from turn so TT is no longer a set; turn brick 2c pairs the board (8h5c2d2c). This is a strong-made hand (overpair to a paired low board) facing BB's 33% probe after flop went check-check. BB's leading range is wide (8x, 5x, weak draws to clubs from 5c+2c two-tone, air-bluffs); TT is well ahead. CALL is preferred over RAISE: raising folds out the air/weak-pair fraction TT dominates and isolates against 22-trips / 88-55 sets. Pot control on paired board, induce river bluffs.

HU spot — TT is overpair on 8h5c2d3c (low rainbow with 2-tone clubs from 5c+3c). Facing BB's 33% probe after flop checked through. Strong-made overpair vs BB's wide probing range (8x, weak pairs, club flush draws, air). CALL extracts from worse and keeps villain's bluff/draw range in; raising into a small probe folds out the dominated portion and isolates against few better hands HU. Compressed SPR ~3.5 supports calling and re-evaluating river.

HU spot — TT is overpair on 8h5c2d4c (low board, 2-tone clubs, mild wheel-draw potential 2-3-4-5). BB probes 33% into checked-flop. Strong-made hand vs BB's wide leading range (8x, low pairs, club draws, air). CALL is standard: small probe size doesn't merit a raise; calling keeps villain's bluffs/draws in and lets us realize equity vs the entire probing range.

HU spot — TT is overpair on 8h5c2d6c. Board has 2-tone clubs (5c+6c) plus light straight-draw connectivity (4-5-6 / 5-6-7-8). Facing BB's 33% probe HU. Strong-made overpair beats nearly all of BB's wide probing range; only 88/66/55 sets and rare 22 beat us. CALL preferred: raising folds out worse and isolates into the few hands that beat us; small probe doesn't compress stacks enough to demand protection.

HU spot — TT is overpair on 8h5c2d7c. Most dynamic of the LK turns: 2-tone clubs plus 5-6-7-8 OESD-territory and 6-7 connectors create more draw equity in BB's probing range. Still strong-made vs wide probe range; TT remains far ahead of BB's 8x/draws/air mix. CALL over RAISE — small probe size, raising charges draws but folds out the air fraction we dominate. Plan: call small probe, evaluate river based on completing card.

HU river spot — board Jc9c5d2s2c brings a club on the river, completing the 3-flush (Jc9c2c). Hero AhJh has TPTK (top pair top kicker) but ZERO club blocker. Facing BTN's polarised 75%-pot triple-barrel after open + 25% flop + 33% turn. Villain's value range on a flush-completing river after triple-barrel densifies heavily to flushes (any two clubs in BTN's opening range: AcXc, KcXc, QcXc, plus natural club combos), plus sets (JJ/99/55) that also beat AJ. Bluff frequency on completed flush rivers is structurally low; without a club blocker, hero cannot reduce villain's value combos. Pot odds 30% — TPTK no-blocker is well under threshold against this densified value range. Additionally the board pairs (2s2c) introducing 22 trips into villain's value side. Clear FOLD.

HU river spot — board Jc9c5d2s3c, river club completes 3-flush. Hero AhJh has TPTK with NO club blocker. Facing BTN's polar 75% river bet after triple-barrel line. Villain's value range densifies to flushes (BTN's opening range contains many club combinations: AcKc/AcQc/KcQc/AcXc/etc., none blocked by hero) plus sets. 3-flush completion + polar size + no club blocker = bluff frequency cannot clear pot-odds threshold (30%). TPTK becomes a bluff-catcher only on dry river runouts; this runout is the worst case. FOLD.

HU river spot — board Jc9c5d2s4c, river club completes 3-flush. Hero AhJh holds TPTK with no club blocker. Facing BTN's polar 75% triple-barrel river. Same mechanic as the other 1.5 LK spots: villain's polar river range on a flush-completing river is value-skewed (flushes hero unblocks, plus sets, plus rivered straights from 6-3 type draws — 3-4-5-6 wheel draws now also have additional combos). Pot odds 30% with TPTK and zero club removal cannot clear bluff threshold. FOLD.

HU river spot — board Jc9c5d2s5c, river club completes 3-flush AND pairs the 5. Hero AhJh has TPTK no-club-blocker. Facing 75% polar triple-barrel. Villain's value densifies to flushes (unblocked) + sets (now 55 trips also added by pairing 5) + JJ. Bluff frequency far too low on this runout. Hero blocks AJ/KJ-of-clubs slightly via Jh but doesn't block any flush. Clear FOLD.

HU river spot — board Jc9c5d2s6c, river club completes 3-flush. Hero AhJh has TPTK with no club blocker. Facing BTN's polar 75% triple-barrel. Villain's value range is densely flushes + sets + possible straights (8-7 turns into a small part now? on Jc9c5d2s6c — 7-8 makes 5-6-7-8-9 straight). Hero unblocks flushes entirely. Pot odds 30% cannot be met by villain's bluff frequency on this densified value-heavy polar range. FOLD.
